entry.title: New: dsh-desktop#plugin
entry.summary: DSH plugin (dsh-desktop-launcher) that launches the dsh-desktop Windows Electron shell from the conversation: double-click to run the DSH web in a standalone window, region screenshot with GPU-accelerated selection that auto-pastes into the chat (works with vision bridges), system tray, session manager, auto environment setup, configurable port, single-instance lock. Exact install spec: dsh-desktop-windows-launcher. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
